# UDPStreamIP <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Network](BlitzBasic-Network)

</div>


```blitzbasic
UDPStreamIP:Int32 udp_stream:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `udp_stream` | In | Int32 | required | The stream. |

**Returns:** The address of this computer that the stream receives on.

## Description

_Not documented yet._

## Differences

* Only IPv4, use [GetUDPStreamAddress](GetUDPStreamAddress) for IPv6 too. It is the first address of this computer that [CountHostIPs](CountHostIPs) finds with an empty name, one that other computers can reach if there is any.
